authority: Michigan Secretary of State, Michigan Bureau of Elections, county clerks, and local clerks
caveat: This is a source inventory for administration context. It records public source locations, collection status, and request needs; it is not a normalized row-level audit, CVR, incident, recount, correction, or litigation dataset and does not allege misconduct.

resultsAndReview.sourceTitle: Michigan Voter Information Center election result downloads
resultsAndReview.scopeNote: County certified presidential rows and precinct President-versus-U.S. Senate review rows are loaded from official MVIC artifacts already committed in the repository. Live MVIC downloads are browser-protected from scripted collection here.

turnoutAndRegistration.caveat: Turnout and registration denominators are county-level and are not same-grain precinct turnout denominators.

historicalBaseline.caveat: Historical rows are contextual secondary county tables. The official MVIC and mielections.us historical result paths should replace them if a script-readable official export can be collected.

geometry.needed: Official statewide precinct boundary geometry or reporting-unit crosswalk matching the MVIC precinct result ZIP keys.
geometry.requestPath: Request precinct boundary geometry, precinct-code crosswalks, or publishable reporting-unit definitions from the Michigan Bureau of Elections, county clerks, or local clerks depending on custody.
geometry.caveat: County geometry supports county map joins only. Do not infer precinct boundaries from county geometry or precinct names.

needed: official 2024 post-election audit selection and outcome artifacts if published or obtainable
official recount petitions, amended canvasses, and recount outcome records for 2024 contests if any were conducted
CVR availability statements or request paths by county/local custodian, including redaction and ballot secrecy caveats
official incident, correction, litigation, and equipment provenance records beyond source-level context
auditRecountCvrIncidentsCorrectionsLitig.requestPath: Use Michigan Bureau of Elections, county clerks, and local clerks as custodians depending on the record family. Preserve county/local custody caveats before normalizing any rows.
auditRecountCvrIncidentsCorrectionsLitig.caveat: No statewide CVR dataset, row-level post-election audit result table, recount package, incident/correction package, or litigation row package is loaded for Michigan 2024.

loadedSupplementalSource.sourceTitle: Verified Voting Verifier Michigan 2024 equipment context

equipmentContext.officialRequestPath: Request official county or local voting-system assignment, certification, and ballot-style/equipment provenance records from the Michigan Bureau of Elections or local election officials if source-native equipment provenance is required.
equipmentContext.caveat: Verified Voting rows are context only and should not be used as vote, turnout, or precinct-uniformity proof.
